2014_spells.shadow-blade.description: You weave together threads of shadow to create a sword of solidified gloom in your hand. This magic sword lasts until the spell ends. It counts as a simple melee weapon with which you are proficient. It deals 2d8 psychic damage on a hit and has the finesse, light, and thrown properties (range 20/60).
2014_spells.shadow-blade.effectSummary: Deal 2d8 psychic damage to a target within Self
2014_spells.shadow-blade.fullDescription: Using 1 bonus action, you weave together threads of shadow to create a sword of solidified gloom in your hand. It deals 2d8 psychic damage on a hit and has the finesse, light, and thrown properties (range 20/60); It counts as a simple melee weapon with which you are proficient; When you cast this spell using a 3rd- or 4th-level spell slot, the damage increases to 3d8; When you cast it using a 5th- or 6th-level spell slot, the damage increases to 4d8; When you cast it using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases to 5d8. This magic sword lasts until the spell ends; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
